customers: SELECT c.customer_no, c.name, c.customer_type, c.risk_level, c.investor_type, c.open_date, c.status, COALESCE(a.account_count, 0) AS account_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_no, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM fund_accounts GROUP BY customer_no) a ON a.customer_no = c.customer_no WHERE (:arg_keyword = '' OR c.customer_no LIKE :arg_like OR c.name LIKE :arg_like) AND (:arg_risk = '' OR c.risk_level = :arg_risk) AND (:arg_type = '' OR c.customer_type = :arg_type) ORDER BY c.customer_no LIMIT :arg_limit OFFSET :arg_offset
customer_count: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM customers c WHERE (:arg_keyword = '' OR c.customer_no LIKE :arg_like OR c.name LIKE :arg_like) AND (:arg_risk = '' OR c.risk_level = :arg_risk) AND (:arg_type = '' OR c.customer_type = :arg_type)
dates: SELECT MIN(trade_date) AS first_date, MAX(trade_date) AS last_date FROM daily_balances
customer_dates: SELECT MIN(trade_date) AS first_date, MAX(trade_date) AS last_date FROM daily_balances WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer
customer: SELECT customer_no, name, customer_type, mobile, risk_level, investor_type, open_date, status FROM customers WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer
accounts: SELECT fund_account_no, currency, status, department_code, manager_id FROM fund_accounts WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer ORDER BY fund_account_no
customer_cash: SELECT SUM(closing_balance) AS cash, SUM(available_balance) AS available, SUM(withdrawable_balance) AS withdrawable FROM daily_balances WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer AND trade_date = :arg_date
customer_holdings: SELECT SUM(market_value_cents) AS holdings FROM positions WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer AND trade_date = :arg_date
customer_activity: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trade_count, SUM(amount_cents) AS turnover, SUM(fee_cents) AS fees FROM trades WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer AND trade_date = :arg_date
positions: SELECT fund_account_no, security_code, quantity, available_quantity, cost_cents, market_value_cents FROM positions WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer AND trade_date = :arg_date ORDER BY fund_account_no, security_code LIMIT :arg_limit OFFSET :arg_offset
positions_count: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM positions WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer AND trade_date = :arg_date
customer_trades: SELECT trade_no, fund_account_no, trade_date, security_code, side, price, quantity, amount_cents, fee_cents FROM trades WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer AND trade_date = :arg_date ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT :arg_limit OFFSET :arg_offset
customer_trades_count: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM trades WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer AND trade_date = :arg_date
flows: SELECT fund_account_no, trade_date, flow_type, amount_cents, fee_cents, balance_after FROM cash_flows WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer AND trade_date = :arg_date ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT :arg_limit OFFSET :arg_offset
flows_count: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM cash_flows WHERE customer_no = :arg_customer AND trade_date = :arg_date
assets: WITH cash AS (SELECT customer_no, SUM(closing_balance) AS cash_value FROM daily_balances WHERE trade_date = :arg_date GROUP BY customer_no), holdings AS (SELECT customer_no, SUM(market_value_cents) AS holdings_value FROM positions WHERE trade_date = :arg_date GROUP BY customer_no) SELECT c.customer_no, c.name, COALESCE(cash.cash_value, 0) + COALESCE(holdings.holdings_value, 0) AS metric FROM customers c LEFT JOIN cash ON cash.customer_no = c.customer_no LEFT JOIN holdings ON holdings.customer_no = c.customer_no WHERE cash.customer_no IS NOT NULL OR holdings.customer_no IS NOT NULL ORDER BY metric DESC, c.customer_no LIMIT :arg_limit
cash: SELECT c.customer_no, c.name, SUM(b.closing_balance) AS metric FROM daily_balances b JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no = b.customer_no WHERE b.trade_date = :arg_date GROUP BY c.customer_no, c.name ORDER BY metric DESC, c.customer_no LIMIT :arg_limit
holdings: SELECT c.customer_no, c.name, SUM(p.market_value_cents) AS metric FROM positions p JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no = p.customer_no WHERE p.trade_date = :arg_date GROUP BY c.customer_no, c.name ORDER BY metric DESC, c.customer_no LIMIT :arg_limit
turnover: SELECT c.customer_no, c.name, SUM(t.amount_cents) AS metric FROM trades t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no = t.customer_no WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN :arg_start AND :arg_end GROUP BY c.customer_no, c.name ORDER BY metric DESC, c.customer_no LIMIT :arg_limit
trade_count: SELECT c.customer_no, c.name, COUNT(*) AS metric FROM trades t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no = t.customer_no WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN :arg_start AND :arg_end GROUP BY c.customer_no, c.name ORDER BY metric DESC, c.customer_no LIMIT :arg_limit
fees: SELECT c.customer_no, c.name, SUM(t.fee_cents) AS metric FROM trades t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no = t.customer_no WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN :arg_start AND :arg_end GROUP BY c.customer_no, c.name ORDER BY metric DESC, c.customer_no LIMIT :arg_limit
net_deposit: SELECT c.customer_no, c.name, SUM(CASE WHEN f.flow_type = 'DEPOSIT' THEN f.amount_cents WHEN f.flow_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN -ABS(f.amount_cents) ELSE 0 END) AS metric FROM cash_flows f JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no = f.customer_no WHERE f.trade_date BETWEEN :arg_start AND :arg_end AND f.flow_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'WITHDRAWAL') GROUP BY c.customer_no, c.name ORDER BY metric DESC, c.customer_no LIMIT :arg_limit
